# PT Launch Lab

> PT Launch Lab is a UK-based personal trainer academy founded by gym owners Callum Brown, Miles, and Ryan. We offer NCFE Level 2 & 3 Personal Trainer qualifications — 100% online, Ofqual regulated, CIMSPA recognised — with business mentorship, personal tutors, and a guaranteed gym introduction built in. Based in Pontefract, West Yorkshire.

- [Home](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/): Overview of the PT Launch Lab course, unique method, social proof, and pricing

- [Enrol](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/enrol): Start your application
- [Book a Call](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/book-call): Free 15-minute consultation with the founders
- [About](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/about): Our story, founders' backgrounds, values, and podcast

- [Graduates](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/graduates): People who qualified with us and what they do now

## For Gym Owners

- [Gym Partnership](https://ptlaunchlab.co.uk/gym-partnership): A white-label PT academy under a gym's own brand. We teach, assess and certify; the gym pays nothing to join and is paid per learner. One partner gym per area

first-hand interviews with working UK personal trainers, gym owners and career changers about

## Key Facts

- Qualification: NCFE Level 2 & 3 Personal Trainer Certificate (Ofqual regulated, CIMSPA recognised)
- Duration: most learners finish in 8–16 weeks (self-paced, fully online; practical units assessed by video)
- Price: £999.99 paid in full, or 10 monthly payments of £99.99 with no interest (first payment at checkout, £999.90 in total). No discounts or promo codes. Rolling enrolment: start any day
- The Mentorship Hub is included in the fee at no extra cost
- Founders have hired 500+ personal trainers across their gym businesses
- 5.0★ Google rating
- A guaranteed gym introduction on qualification: we approach at least one gym for the learner, from our partner network or local to them. Whether the gym interviews and hires is the gym's decision
- Who it suits best: career changers who want help getting their first clients, not just the certificate
- Personal tutor assigned throughout the course
- Business training included as a core module (not optional)
- Based in Pontefract, West Yorkshire, UK
